Type: ottoman
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Wingard Leather Ottoman, 26.4"W, Cognac
Colors: Cognac
This classic leather ottoman in Cognac most certainly has contemporary flair. Spruce up any room with this charming piece, ready to support your feet or serve as extra seating. Solid wood frame with 100% top-grain leather; assemble in 15 minutes or less Product Dimensions: 26.38"W x 16.54"D x 18.9"H Care Instructions: Avoid moisture; wipe down with a clean, soft cloth Free returns for 30 days; 3-year warranty
